description.en: WuYu-EnvLE-Bench evaluates LLMs on environmental law enforcement with 2,521 instances across 14 tasks and 12 pollution-medium subdomains, covering pre-, in-, and post-enforcement workflows. It uses Absolute Environmental Enforcement Score (AES) and Intelligent Enforcement Index (IEI) for evaluation.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: The benchmark fills a gap in evaluating LLMs for evidence-grounded, rule-aware reasoning in environmental enforcement. It provides practical assessment of model reliability in traceable decision-making, highlighting limitations in evidence-chain construction and procedural judgment, which is critical for legal and regulatory applications.
